# `/search` endpoints

Base URL: `https://{tenant}.api.identitynow.com`

### POST /search/v1

`searchPostV1` — Perform search

Perform a search with the provided query and return a matching result collection. To page past 10,000 records, you can use `searchAfter` paging. Refer to [Paginating Search Queries](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters#paginating-search-queries) for more information about how to implement `searchAfter` paging. The search query itself has a size limitation of approximately 800 objects when filtering by large lists of IDs or values (e.g., using `terms` filters…

- Scopes: sp:search:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 10000 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Body (application/json): search
- Returns 200: array of searchdocuments

### POST /search/v1/count

`searchCountV1` — Count documents satisfying a query

Performs a search with a provided query and returns the count of results in the X-Total-Count header.

- Scopes: sp:search:read
- Body (application/json): search
- Returns 204: no body

### POST /search/v1/aggregate

`searchAggregateV1` — Perform a search query aggregation

Performs a search query aggregation and returns the aggregation result. By default, you can page a maximum of 10,000 search result records. To page past 10,000 records, you can use searchAfter paging. Refer to [Paginating Search Queries](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters#paginating-search-queries) for more information about how to implement searchAfter paging.

- Scopes: sp:search:read
- Parameters:
  - `offset` (query) — default 0 — Offset into the full result set. Usually specified with *limit* to paginate through the results. See [API Standard Collection…
  - `limit` (query) — max 250 — default 250 — Max number of results to return. See [API Standard Collection Parameters](https://developer.sailpoint.com/docs/api/standard-collection-parameters) for more information.
  - `count` (query) — default False — If *true* it will populate the *X-Total-Count* response header with the number of results that would be returned if *limit* and *offset* were ignored. Since requesting a total count can have a…
- Body (application/json): search
- Returns 200: aggregationresult

### GET /search/v1/{index}/{id}

`searchGetV1` — Get a document by id

Fetches a single document from the specified index, using the specified document ID. **Note:** Response fields with an underscore (`_`) prefix, such as `_type` and `_index`, are internal metadata fields. These fields are for SailPoint internal use only and are subject to change without notice. Do not rely on them in your integrations.

- Scopes: sp:search:read
- User levels: ORG_ADMIN, CERT_ADMIN, REPORT_ADMIN, SOURCE_ADMIN, SOURCE_SUBADMIN, ROLE_ADMIN, ROLE_SUBADMIN
- Parameters:
  - `index` (path, required) — one of accessprofiles, accountactivities, entitlements, events, identities, roles, workflowsummaries — The index from which to fetch the specified document. The currently supported index names are: *accessprofiles*, *accountactivities*, *entitlements*, *events*, *identities*, *roles*, and…
  - `id` (path, required) — ID of the requested document.
- Returns 200: searchdocument
